newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Aluminium rises to new 1997 high.
newsitem.headline: Showa Aluminium rises to new 1997 high.

text.p: Shares of Showa Aluminium Corp rose on Tuesday morning and briefly reached a new high for the calendar year on the strong earnings the firm reported last week, traders said.
The aluminum processor briefly climbed to 671, its highest price so far in 1997. At 0041 GMT, the shares were up 15 yen at 665. Turnover was 1.208 million shares.
Last week, the firm said its group net profits surged 70.9 percent to 4.1 billion yen for 1996/97, from 2.4 billion yen a year earlier.
